title: CSOgroup/TrESFlow pipeline parameters
description: Repo-owned Nextflow DSL2 implementation of the TrES core RNA and DNA workflows

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Reserved nf-core schema placeholder. TrESFlow uses --samplesheet as the supported public input contract.

samplesheet.description: Hierarchical YAML samplesheet describing runtime, references, biological groups, and modality-specific FASTQ inputs. A relative path is resolved from the Nextflow launch directory.

outdir.description: Output directory for published pipeline results and pipeline_info artifacts. Relative paths are resolved from the Nextflow launch directory; the default is <launch-directory>/results.

publish_split_fastqs.description: Publish gzip-compressed RNA and DNA split FASTQ copies under rna_split_fastqs/ and dna_split_fastqs/. Internal uncompressed split FASTQs are always retained long enough for downstream computation.

execution_options.title: Execution options
execution_options.description: Pipeline execution options. Runtime environment and references are configured in the YAML samplesheet.

core_scripts_dir.description: Optional override for the TrES core runtime scripts. A relative override is resolved from the Nextflow launch directory; when omitted, the repository-owned scripts/core_runtime directory is used.

max_cpus.description: Maximum local CPU budget used to derive per-process scheduler reservations in the bundled local profiles.

cleanup_work.description: Enable Nextflow cleanup of successful task work directories after a successful run. This reduces retained work/ storage and makes --resume unreliable for cleaned tasks.

tagging_cpus.description: Default local CPU reservation for barcode-tagging processes. The value is capped by --max_cpus.

tagging_memory.description: Default local memory reservation for barcode-tagging processes.

trim_cpus.description: Default CPU reservation for RNA and DNA Trim Galore processes. The value is capped by --max_cpus.

trim_memory.description: Default memory reservation for RNA and DNA Trim Galore processes.

artifact_filter_cpus.description: Default CPU reservation for the dual-tag Cutadapt artifact-filter process. The value is capped by --max_cpus.

artifact_filter_memory.description: Default memory reservation for the dual-tag Cutadapt artifact-filter process.

rna_starsolo_cpus.description: Default CPU reservation for RNA_STARSOLO_ALIGN. The value is capped by --max_cpus.

rna_starsolo_memory.description: Default memory reservation for RNA_STARSOLO_ALIGN, including the STAR genome index.

rna_coverage_cpus.description: Default CPU reservation for STAR-based RNA_COVERAGE. The value is capped by --max_cpus.

rna_coverage_memory.description: Default memory reservation for STAR-based RNA_COVERAGE.

dna_align_cpus.description: Default CPU reservation for ALIGN_DNA and its bwa-mem2/samtools wrapper. The value is capped by --max_cpus.

dna_align_memory.description: Default memory reservation for ALIGN_DNA, including bwa-mem2 and threaded samtools sorting.

dna_markdup_memory.description: Default memory reservation for GATK/Picard MarkDuplicates.

dna_coverage_cpus.description: Default CPU reservation for deepTools bamCoverage. The value is capped by --max_cpus.

dna_coverage_memory.description: Default memory reservation for deepTools bamCoverage.

aviti_optical_duplicate_distance.description: Empirical AVITI coordinate-distance threshold used by Picard MarkDuplicates for spatial/optical duplicate classification. Default 10, calibrated on AVITI 500 data. This is not an Illumina pixel-distance setting and may be overridden for independently calibrated datasets.

filter_dual_tag_artifacts.description: After Trim Galore, discard dual-tagmentation DNA read pairs when either trimmed mate still contains an audited exact 23-nt linker signature. Enabled by default and never applied to single-tagmentation or RNA reads.

publish_dir_mode.description: PublishDir mode applied by the lightweight modules.config layer.

config_profile_name.description: Optional human-readable active profile name used in reporting.

config_profile_description.description: Optional human-readable active profile description used in reporting.

custom_config_version.description: Version selector for remote nf-core/configs loading.

custom_config_base.description: Base URL used to load remote nf-core/configs institutional profiles.

advanced_options.title: Advanced options
advanced_options.description: Internal advanced defaults kept out of the main public YAML input contract.

barcode_defaults.description: Internal barcode parsing defaults used by the samplesheet parser and local wrapper modules.
